• Tap each burger item → set quantity to **5**.
• Tap each chicken wing option → set quantity to **6**.
If there isn’t a single “Chicken Wings” line item, pick the closest equivalent (e.g., “Wings & Fries Combo”) and adjust quantities accordingly. | | 5️⃣ | **Review your cart** – make sure all numbers match what you want. | | 6️⃣ | **Proceed to checkout** – confirm delivery address, choose payment method, then hit *Place Order*. | ### Tips: * If you’re unsure which specific burger(s) you’d like, start with the most popular ones—like the Big Mac or Quarter Pounder—and tweak later if needed. * Some menus list “Wing Packs”; double‑check whether those include extra sides or sauces before adding more than one pack. * Keep an eye out for promotions; sometimes McDonald’s offers free fries or drinks with certain orders.
